cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) (ether/sulfonate type) with prominent buffer(s) Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine (3), Coco-Glucoside (5) and no prominent reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate. Kaolin (8) is clay, not a cleansing route (C3).
counterSignals: Kaolin (8) adds an absorbent clay element (not a surfactant route)

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: prominent cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (9) with humectant Sodium Hyaluronate (6); no silicone, lipid or pearlizer, so C2 is not met and high is not reachable.
counterSignals: clay (Kaolin 8) and a cleansing-led short list argue toward low

weightPotential.rationale: low: the only depositing route is one cationic guar facing a moderate C1 reset; noticeable loss of lift is unlikely.

depositionLoad.rationale: Single deposition family: one cationic guar (9) in a 13-ingredient list; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former.

persistence.rationale: A single guar in an ordinary rinse-off base is weakly retained; clay contributes no persistent film.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 SLES chassis with sultaine and glucoside buffers; Kaolin absorbent adds a little oil-uptake but is not a surfactant route.

weightPotential.whyThisBand: low: the only depositing route is one cationic guar facing a moderate C1 reset; noticeable loss of lift is unlikely.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: only one deposition family (no W2 trigger), no silicone/lipid/protein reinforcement; a single light polymer facing moderate reset stays low (no polymer floor).
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: INCI-only: guar charge density/level unknown; could plausibly move to moderate.

focusPrimary.rationale: Blind pass: claims hidden, so no positioned job can be confirmed; clay + light architecture is compatible with clarifying (F6: cleansing moderate, C/W not high); hyaluronate could support a moisture claim weakly.

careDirection.note: single humectant (Sodium Hyaluronate 6) plus guar; not a coherent humectant cluster

focusSecondary.rationale: Empty default; a secondary needs distinct exact-product positioning (Section 8), not visible blind.

usageRole.rationale: Default regular (Section 9); every non-default trigger needs a claim graded moderate/high, hidden in the blind pass. alternating impossible (cleansing not strong); frequent needs explicit frequency wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Blind: no positioning visible (SC1). Formula half CSA PASSES (prominent E4 routes: Sodium Hyaluronate (6) humectant, Niacinamide (7) comfort). If an E2 sensitive/dry unit graded moderate/high appears after unblinding, targeted is reachable.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole (Section 11) -> not_supported.

uncertainties.reading: conditioning moderate (lone prominent guar = one meaningful system)
